subject: mathematics
concept: Converting between fractions (tenths/hundredths) and their decimal equivalents
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student compares a shaded fraction tile to an equivalent shaded hundredths grid
exercise.pictorial: Student matches fraction bar models to their decimal grid equivalents
exercise.abstract: Student converts between fractions with denominator 10/100 and their decimal form

misconception_flags: misaligns place value when converting (e.g. writes 3/100 as 0.3)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
